description: What a GP-led continuation fund is, the conflict of interest at its center from both the GP's and the LP's side, who has a stake in the outcome without a vote, the behavioral framing of the 'roll or cash out' decision, and whether longer hold periods serve patient capital or defer accountability. Includes a gender-lens hypothesis, labeled as such. Full content with an active plugin subscription; otherwise lesson titles and key takeaways only.
name: pe_secondaries.deep_dive_track
title: PE/VC Secondaries & Continuation Funds
